question: Can you provide a breakdown of how many times each product was viewed, how many times they were added to the shopping cart, and how many times they were left in the cart without being purchased? Also, give me the count of actual purchases for each product. Ensure that products with a page id in (1, 2, 12, 13) are filtered out.
sql:
WITH product_events AS (
    SELECT 
        ph.product_id,
        se.event_type,
        se.visit_id
    FROM shopping_cart_events se
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy ph ON se.page_id = ph.page_id
    WHERE ph.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
),
purchase_visits AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT se.visit_id
    FROM shopping_cart_events se
    WHERE se.event_type = 3
),
viewed AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(pe.product_id AS INTEGER) AS product_id,
        COUNT(*) as viewed
    FROM product_events pe
    WHERE pe.event_type = 1
    GROUP BY pe.product_id
),
added AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(pe.product_id AS INTEGER) AS product_id,
        COUNT(*) as added_to_cart
    FROM product_events pe
    WHERE pe.event_type = 2
    GROUP BY pe.product_id
),
left_in_cart AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(pe.product_id AS INTEGER) AS product_id,
        COUNT(*) as left_in_cart
    FROM product_events pe
    WHERE pe.event_type = 2
    AND pe.visit_id NOT IN (SELECT visit_id FROM purchase_visits)
    GROUP BY pe.product_id
),
purchased AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(pe.product_id AS INTEGER) AS product_id,
        COUNT(*) as purchases
    FROM product_events pe
    WHERE pe.event_type = 2
    AND pe.visit_id IN (SELECT visit_id FROM purchase_visits)
    GROUP BY pe.product_id
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(v.product_id, a.product_id, l.product_id, p.product_id) AS product_id,
    COALESCE(v.viewed, 0) AS products_viewed,
    COALESCE(a.added_to_cart, 0) AS added_to_cart,
    COALESCE(l.left_in_cart, 0) AS left_in_cart_without_purchase,
    COALESCE(p.purchases, 0) AS actual_purchases
FROM viewed v
FULL OUTER JOIN added a ON v.product_id = a.product_id
FULL OUTER JOIN left_in_cart l ON v.product_id = l.product_id
FULL OUTER JOIN purchased p ON v.product_id = p.product_id
ORDER BY product_id
